job.text: Scorecard turns a project into a short descriptive site: what was built, what works, what does not, and how to run it.

brief.text: Give authors a diary-like manual for any project type without grading them.

outcome.text: A Vite kit, Write mode, and agent skill (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, …) that scaffold Lite, Standard, or Full sites from an interview.

knownGap.text: Desktop launcher and hosted Write mode are deferred.

built.text: Interview skill, JSON content model, kit UI, generators, CLI.

borrowed.text: React, Vite, TipTap, Paleologue fonts, Nouveau ornaments (author OSS).

proof.text: Run npx scorecard-kit dev and open / for the full home or /scorecard for status.

next.text: Keep /demos packs honest as the product evolves; polish Look gallery.
